newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Refining in 15-year propylene contract.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Refining in 15-year propylene contract.

text.p: Singapore Petroleum Co Ltd (SPC) and its partners at Singapore Refining Co (SRC) have won a contract to supply 90,000 tonne-per-year of refinery grade propylene to Eastman Chemical, SPC said in a statement.
The contract will run for 15 years from around November 1998.
A company official said he was "not prepared to quantify the value of the contract."
Based on the current propylene value of around $550 per tonne, the annual value of the contract would be around $500 million and SPC has a one-third share.
